name: sm8850
notes: soc_id 660 is the Android SoC ID reported by /sys/devices/soc0/soc_id. An earlier pin used 660 as soc_model; that conflated the two schemes, and the acceptance run below settles it: a context compiled with soc_model 87 loads and executes on a device whose soc_id is 660.
